correctness.rationale: A single two-step reversal yields exactly one directed triangle. Hence exhaustive path-forest face membership follows from the source/target uniqueness and cycle test. The package supplies two independent complete face enumerations, two transposed GF2 boundary-rank computations at each degree, checks that boundary-squares vanish, and explicit rank tables. Its exact finite data give unequal second and third reduced mod-two Betti numbers despite identical full face vectors, and check every position up to order six. All computational assertions re-executed from this same package; no extension beyond finite parameters is inferred.

value.rationale: A natural minimal perturbation family of transitive tournaments exhibits its first positional homology effect at order seven, despite equal entire face-count data and the same unique directed triangle. This explicitly isolates a structural boundary of enumeration-based topological inference for directed-linear-forest complexes, a concrete motivated counterexample rather than an arbitrary invariant. Its finite scope is not falsely amplified into an all-order theorem.
